meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织好画面轨道与子合成,让项目如期渲染
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做动画合成,想一次写对项目结构避免返工
copy.tagline_en: Organize tracks and sub-compositions to make your project render reliably
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're creating animated compositions and want to get the structure right without rework

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把视频项目写成 HTML 文件:用 data-* 属性规定时间轴,用 class="clip" 标记片段,支持子合成、变量和媒体播放,并遵守确定性渲染规则;也覆盖 Tailwind 项目和 STORYBOARD/SCRIPT 计划格式。
howto.when: 当你要创建或修改 HyperFrames 视频项目,或提到 data-* 时间属性、clip、子合成、变量、媒体、确定性渲染、校验、Tailwind 及 STORYBOARD/SCRIPT 计划格式时。

say.text: 帮我搭一个最小的 HyperFrames 合成骨架,根节点要带尺寸。
say.note: Claude 会输出可渲染的 HTML 骨架。

say.text: 把这个视频项目改成子合成,用 template 包装并接好宿主 id。
say.note: Claude 会按约定接线,避免静默错误。

say.text: 用 npx hyperframes check 校验当前项目。
say.note: 返回 lint、运行时、布局、动效、对比度检查结果。

howto.what_en: Claude follows the HyperFrames composition contract: builds a video project as HTML with data-* timing and class="clip", supports tracks, sub-comps, variables, media, deterministic renders; covers Tailwind and STORYBOARD/SCRIPT formats.
howto.when_en: When you create or edit a HyperFrames video project, write composition HTML, or mention data-* timing, clip, sub-compositions, variables, media playback, deterministic rendering, validation, or Tailwind/STORYBOARD/SCRIPT plan formats.

say_en.text: Write a minimal HyperFrames composition with a sized root and data-duration.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a renderable HTML skeleton.

say_en.text: Make this project a sub-composition: wrap it in a template and match the host id.
say_en.note: Claude wires it per contract to avoid silent errors.

say_en.text: Run npx hyperframes check on this project.
say_en.note: Returns lint, runtime, layout, motion, contrast results.
